H1_limited_forecastability.evidence: Persistence mean R2 0.071 at 20 frames and -0.365 at 50 frames; no model has positive mean skill vs persistence at any tested horizon.

H2_observation_model_mismatch.evidence: Calcium-filtered synthetic controls have lower attainable skill; the causal calcium model improves one-step real skill (-0.529) but explodes at H20/H100 and does not beat persistence.

H3_missing_state_variables.evidence: Population VAR improves modestly over independent neurons but remains far below persistence; no direct measurement of the missing state.

H4_inadequate_model_identification.evidence: Test-third performance degrades monotonically; half-split latent subspaces differ by 56-62 degrees despite 3-6 degree bootstrap stability.

H5_data_evaluation_mismatch.evidence: Test reconstruction R2 is negative for all five sessions; later test thirds are worse for every model.

H6_structural_non_identifiability.evidence: Cross-model perturbation cosine is near zero for compositional vs latent/VAR models; target-ranking median Spearman is 0.371.

FORECASTABILITY_CHARACTERIZED.definition: Per-neuron, per-session and horizon-resolved skill versus persistence/mean/trend was measured with the same starts.

OBSERVATION_MODEL_TESTED.definition: Synthetic known-truth and real causal observation-aware tests were executed; the real autonomous model did not improve.

IDENTIFIABILITY_ASSESSED.definition: Effective dimension, half-split and bootstrap subspace stability, eigenvalues, observability and reconstruction were measured.

OXYGEN_RESPONSE_ASSESSED.definition: Verified event times, directions, reliability, direction contrast and time/placebo controls were evaluated; no reproducible response was established.

PERTURBATION_UNCERTAINTY_CHARACTERIZED.definition: Five model forms were compared on the same mapped virtual perturbation; disagreement and resampling stability were quantified.

BIOLOGICAL_INTERVENTION_VALIDATION.definition: Requires a matched experimental perturbation with independent animals; none is available.

key_negatives: No tested model beats persistence on mean held-out skill.
The causal calcium LDS is numerically unstable in autonomous rollout.
Oxygen transitions do not produce a reproducible response vector and are confounded with elapsed time.
Virtual perturbation directions are model-dependent; no biological intervention claim is justified.
warnings: NoStim test tails were previously inspected; this is exploratory, not a newly untouched confirmatory test.
Sessions are repeated recordings, not independent animals.
MODEL-DEPENDENT VIRTUAL PERTURBATION — NOT CAUSALLY VALIDATED.
